newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London extend Hang Seng losses.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London extend Hang Seng losses.

text.p: Hong Kong shares drifted lower in London on Friday, continuing the market's retreat in Hong Kong earlier today, dealers said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index of leading Hong Kong stocks traded here fell 28.22 points to 12,861.15 by 1525 GMT, extending the Hang Seng's 115.43-point loss in Hong Kong.
Dealers said the banking sector had come under pressure in Hong Kong and this had filtered through into London but volumes had been thin.
"We have seen a little profit-taking in the banks other than HSBC but not many people want to get involved before the weekend," said one trader."
Hang Seng Bank was quoted down 65 HK cents from its Hong Kong close at HK$94.1 and Bank of East Asia was off 15 HK cents at HK$ 31.75.
